crossRefs.note: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens…
David therefore departed from there, and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard…
Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented, gathered themselves to him…
Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from…
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…

translations.web: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.
translations.bsb: so that they lived on the slopes of the wadis, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.
translations.kjv: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
translations.asv: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, In holes of the earth and of the rocks.
